  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

  • applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Must-haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Experience – EC2, Security Groups, Command Line usage
  • Terraform Experience – Command line and coding experience to stand up cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update permissions on security groups (following existing formats)
  • Linux Environment – Experience with Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & Automation – Ability to write scripts for deployment using Packer or Terraform


Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.


Benefits Information – CLT

This is a CLT opportunity. You are eligible for 15 days annual holidays/sick time and 30 days annual time off. Benefits also include an FTGS contribution, social security contribution, and a meal voucher. Annual salary will be paid in local currency (REAL), and ranges based on years of experience and skillset. Full details on time off listed below. Medical/healthcare is NOT provided due to the public healthcare system.

EOR (CLT) in Brazil have all the statutory benefits:

  • Meal Voucher
  • Social Security
  • Workers Compensation Insurance
  • State Pension Fund


Paid Time Off

Both full-time and part-time employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid time off (PTO) a year. PTO accrues monthly at 2.5 days per month. Employees are eligible for annual leave after 1 year of work. During the first year of employment, an employee is not allowed to take any leave.

title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer (Node.js / React / AdTech) – Contract (6+ Months, Extension Likely)

Location: Remote (EU Time Zones)

Contract Length: 6 months – strong potential for long-term extensions

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: Node.js, React, APIs, Social/YouTube integrations, AdTech, Creator/UGC discovery


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Engineer to help build a next-generation AdTech platform , supporting categories such as beauty, lifestyle, UGC, and topic-based recommendations for a Euro Retail and Marketing powerhouse.


This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.


This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.


Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences


API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale


AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams


Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD


Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact


Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.

  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work
  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.


Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.


Condições de Trabalho

  • Pacote de compensações competitivas
  • Ambiente de trabalho estimulante e colaborativo

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:


O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.

  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.

  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações \"de linha pontilhada\".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

  • Understanding of good unit and functional test writing
  • Familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in energy industry software, particularly upstream or midstream workflows
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

Com o uso por dezenas de escritórios ao redor do Brasil, o AdvSpace integra gestão, atendimento e automação com Inteligência Artificial, aumentando a produtividade em escala.

Esta é uma oportunidade para participar da história de um produto digital em crescimento.


Missão da Prestação de Serviços


Produzir soluções em forma de software para o AdvSpace, atuando na evolução contínua do produto, seja na melhoria de funcionalidades existentes, seja na construção de novas soluções, com foco em qualidade técnica, prazos e alinhamento com os objetivos do sistema.


Principais Atividades / Entregas


  • Desenvolver código para o AdvSpace conforme processos e padrões de qualidade acordados.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento técnico e de planejamento, quando previamente agendadas.
  • Participar de encontros de atualização técnica e de produto que sejam relevantes para a boa execução dos serviços.
  • Sugerir melhorias em produtos e/ou processos existentes relacionados ao AdvSpace.
  • Reportar as entregas realizadas e em andamento, conforme rotinas de acompanhamento combinadas.
  • Documentar tecnicamente as implementações realizadas, quando necessário para manutenção futura.



Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Algoritmo e Programação.
  • Lógica-Matemática.
  • Inteligência Artificial.
  • HTML 5.
  • React.
  • Python.
  • Typescript.
  • Serverless.
  • PostgreSQL.
  • Git.
  • RESTful API.
  • CI/CD.
  • Clean Code.
  • Interpretação de texto.
  • Inglês avançado (boa leitura e escrita).


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Transparência.
  • Comprometimento.
  • Comunicação.
  • Pensamento crítico.
  • Idoneidade.
  • Autocontrole.



Formação e Experiência


Formação mínima: Estudante de Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência desejável: Não é necessária experiência profissional prévia; experiência em projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais será considerada.

Certificações / cursos complementares: Certificações e cursos relacionados às tecnologias e competências indicadas na vaga serão considerados diferenciais.


Indicadores de Resultado

  • Cumprimento de prazos de entrega.
  • Qualidade técnica das entregas (baixa taxa de retrabalho).
  • Aderência aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos definidos.
  • Evolução contínua na capacidade de contribuição para o produto.



Relacionamentos Internos e Externos


Relacionamentos internos: Ponto de contato técnico, integrantes da equipe de tecnologia, áreas operacional, marketing e vendas, quando necessário para execução das entregas.

Relacionamentos externos: Parceiros de integração do AdvSpace, quando houver necessidade técnica de alinhamento.



Ferramentas e Tecnologias Utilizadas


  • Supabase.
  • Vercel.
  • Windsurf.
  • Lovable.
  • GitHub.
  • Sistema da empresa.
  • Linear.
  • Google Workspace.



Perfil Ideal do Profissional


Profissional planejador e/ou analítico, com interesse genuíno em atuar em produto digital, capacidade de resolver problemas de forma estruturada, abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender continuamente.



Organização do trabalho:

  • Não há controle formal de jornada. O(a) profissional organiza seus próprios horários, desde que cumpra as entregas e prazos combinados.
  • A dedicação semanal será alinhada previamente, de acordo com o volume de demandas.
  • Reuniões de alinhamento e planejamento ocorrerão, em regra, em horário comercial (entre 9h e 18h, de segunda a sexta-feira).


Exclusividade:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Como Senior Data Engineer na área de Analytics & IA da Sankhya, você terá a missão de projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções escaláveis de dados, desenhar arquiteturas eficientes, garantir governança, segurança e alta performance. Atuará em colaboração com squads multidisciplinares, impulsionando inovação e contribuindo para a evolução da BIA e dos produtos inteligentes da Sankhya.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes, suportando operações em larga escala.
  • Atuar na modernização da stack de dados, avaliando novas tecnologias e frameworks.
  • Construir e manter plataformas de dados para suportar produtos analíticos e de inteligência artificial.
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, implementando processos robustos de validação, auditoria e monitoramento.
  • Trabalhar na orquestração de pipelines, utilizando ferramentas como Apache Airflow.
  • Implementar soluções serverless e arquiteturas distribuídas, otimizando custo e performance.
  • Atuar na governança e segurança de dados, garantindo conformidade com regulamentações (LGPD, GDPR).
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e data products para integração entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com Product Managers e Data Scientists para transformar dados em insights estratégicos.
  • Monitorar tendências tecnológicas e de mercado, propondo inovações alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Proficiência avançada em SQL e otimização de queries.
  • Domínio em Python, Scala e/ou Java para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Sólida experiência em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de workflows (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Conhecimento avançado em monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch).
  • Experiência na implementação de DataOps, CI/CD e automação de deploys.
  • Domínio de segurança e compliance de dados (LGPD, GDPR, ISO 27001).
  • Experiência na criação de produtos de dados e APIs escaláveis para consumo interno e externo.
  • Experiência avançada com Data Governance e Catalogação de Dados (Data Catalog, Apache Atlas, Collibra).
  • Vivência em arquitetura orientada a eventos e soluções de baixa latência.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Decskill was founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company and their main mission is to delivery value through the knowledge. We enable companies to meet the chalenges of digital world by providing our clients with business models that ensure technological capacity, flexibility and agility. We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.


DECSKILL operates in 3 main areas:


• DECSKILL TALENT, through which we provide our clients with an extension to their IT teams;

• DECSKILL BOOST, through which we provide our client with software development models to increase capacity and optimize Time-to-Market, where we create and manage teams that deliver according to their needs, at the desired speed;

• DECSKILL CONNECT, through which we provide our client with consulting services, as well as the implementation and management of information technology infrastructures.


Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.


We are looking for a Senior Java Developer for a remote project in Brazil.


Key requirements :


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java development and proficiency in the latest editions of Java, including expertise in Spring Boot.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Microservices architecture, and design patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in frontend technologies like React.js or Angular is a strong plus.
  • Experience in NodeJs and PostgreSQL database is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of security best practices related to APIs and data privacy.
  • Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and a commitment to driving Agile practices within the team.
  • Comfortable with DevOps practices involving configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, Gitflow, IaC, deployment patterns among others.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
  • Proficiency in English is a must.


Role and Key Accountabilities:


  • Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of the applications.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to ensure alignment with business requirements and meet delivery timelines.
  • Prioritize and facilitate the early resolution of client issues, ensuring adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Conduct code reviews, contribute to critical feature designs, and ensure the overall quality of the team's deliverables.
  • Flag technical debt and areas of improvements, making sure they are properly documented and taken into account when defining priorities.
  • Implement a robust documentation system for knowledge base, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and communication in software development activities.
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to these problems.
  • Follow Agile Scrum development process for application development.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference “DA/SJD” .

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.

Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados.   • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;

  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.
